 Given by [[Steps Obliss]] once a day, after talking to to her for 13 days in total and fetching Seeing the Impossible: Behind the Dark Curtain from [[Turn the Page (quest)]].

This item, when equipped, allows you to see hidden chests in certain quests related to the [[Vecna]] storyline ([[The Hand and the Eyes]] in [[Grip of the Hidden Hand]], and [[The Evil We Know]], [[Taken in Hand]], and [[Vecna Denied]] in [[Vecna Unleashed]]) which contain [[Dust of Vile Darkness]], a type crafting ingredient used at the [[Esoteric Table]] and [[Unholy Defiler of the Hidden Hand]].
